message.content: {"title":"AERO9500 Preliminary Report (Part 1) – Space Mission Design","overview":"Design a simple space mission benefiting Australia and identify main space-segment elements (launch, orbits, etc.) using chosen mission-design software, supplemented by hand calculations as needed. Part 1 is a preliminary report laying out the mission concept and rationale, project plan, and preliminary technical progress.","deliverables":["Preliminary report (Part 1) as a single PDF","Mission concept and rationale","Project plan with Gantt chart or timetable and planned information sources","Preliminary technical progress/evidence of work done to date"],"format":{"length":"Around 2–3 pages","structure":"Sections covering mission concept/rationale, project plan, and preliminary progress","other":"Single PDF; use chosen software (STK, PIGI, or other approved) and supplement with hand calculations as needed"},"requirements":[{"id":"R1","text":"Design a space mission that benefits Australia in some way."},{"id":"R2","text":"Keep the mission concept simple."},{"id":"R3","text":"Identify the main elements of the mission's space segment, applying course material on launch, orbits, and related systems."},{"id":"R4","text":"Develop a preliminary plan for the new mission."},{"id":"R5","text":"Present the mission concept and rationale: what it will do, who the users are, and why it is needed."},{"id":"R6","text":"Provide a project plan for completing the assignment, including a Gantt chart or timetable."},{"id":"R7","text":"List the sources of information planned for use."},{"id":"R8","text":"Decide and state which software package is being used (e.g., STK, PIGI, or other)."},{"id":"R9","text":"Contact the instructor before starting work with software other than STK or PIGI."},{"id":"R10","text":"Use software of choice to complete the design, supplementing with hand calculations as needed."},{"id":"R11","text":"Present preliminary progress with technical content and evidence of sufficient work done to date."},{"id":"R12","text":"Submit the report as a single PDF document."}]}
